   43   # The maximum number of hits in a round this move will actually perform. This
   44   # can be 1 for Beat Up, and can be 2 for any moves affected by Parental Bond.
   45   def pbNumHits(user, targets)
   46     if user.hasActiveAbility?(:PARENTALBOND) && pbDamagingMove? &&
   47        !chargingTurnMove? && targets.length == 1
   48       # Record that Parental Bond applies, to weaken the second attack
   49       user.effects[PBEffects::ParentalBond] = 3
   50       return 2
   51     end
   52     return 1
   53   end

  106   def pbMoveFailedLastInRound?(user, showMessage = true)
  107     unmoved = @battle.allBattlers.any? do |b|
  108       next b.index != user.index &&
  109            [:UseMove, :Shift].include?(@battle.choices[b.index][0]) &&
  110            !b.movedThisRound?
  111     end
  112     if !unmoved
  113       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if showMessage
  114       return true
  115     end
  116     return false
  117   end

  161   # Weaken the damage dealt (doesn't actually change a battler's HP)
  162   #=============================================================================
  163   def pbCheckDamageAbsorption(user, target)
  164     # Substitute will take the damage
  165     if target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0 && !ignoresSubstitute?(user) &&
  166        (!user || user.index != target.index)
  167       target.damageState.substitute = true
  168       return
  169     end
  170     # Ice Face will take the damage
  171     if !@battle.moldBreaker && target.isSpecies?(:EISCUE) &&
  172        target.form == 0 && target.ability == :ICEFACE && physicalMove?
  173       target.damageState.iceFace = true
  174       return
  175     end
  176     # Disguise will take the damage
  177     if !@battle.moldBreaker && target.isSpecies?(:MIMIKYU) &&
  178        target.form == 0 && target.ability == :DISGUISE
  179       target.damageState.disguise = true
  180       return
  181     end
  182   end

  184   def pbReduceDamage(user, target)
  185     damage = target.damageState.calcDamage
  186     # Substitute takes the damage
  187     if target.damageState.substitute
  188       damage = target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] if damage > target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute]
  189       target.damageState.hpLost       = damage
  190       target.damageState.totalHPLost += damage
  191       return
  192     end
  193     # Disguise/Ice Face takes the damage
  194     return if target.damageState.disguise || target.damageState.iceFace
  195     # Target takes the damage
  196     if damage >= target.hp
  197       damage = target.hp
  198       # Survive a lethal hit with 1 HP effects
  199       if nonLethal?(user, target)
  200         damage -= 1
  201       elsif target.effects[PBEffects::Endure]
  202         target.damageState.endured = true
  203         damage -= 1
  204       elsif damage == target.totalhp
  205         if target.hasActiveAbility?(:STURDY) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  206           target.damageState.sturdy = true
  207           damage -= 1
  208         elsif target.hasActiveItem?(:FOCUSSASH) && target.hp == target.totalhp
  209           target.damageState.focusSash = true
  210           damage -= 1
  211         elsif target.hasActiveItem?(:FOCUSBAND) && @battle.pbRandom(100) < 10
  212           target.damageState.focusBand = true
  213           damage -= 1
  214         elsif Settings::AFFECTION_EFFECTS && @battle.internalBattle &&
  215               target.pbOwnedByPlayer? && !target.mega?
  216           chance = [0, 0, 0, 10, 15, 25][target.affection_level]
  217           if chance > 0 && @battle.pbRandom(100) < chance
  218             target.damageState.affection_endured = true
  219             damage -= 1
  220           end
  221         end
  222       end
  223     end
  224     damage = 0 if damage < 0
  225     target.damageState.hpLost       = damage
  226     target.damageState.totalHPLost += damage
  227   end

  230   # Change the target's HP by the amount calculated above

  232   def pbInflictHPDamage(target)
  233     if target.damageState.substitute
  234       target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] -= target.damageState.hpLost
  235     elsif target.damageState.hpLost > 0
  236       target.pbReduceHP(target.damageState.hpLost, false, true, false)
  237     end
  238   end

  241   # Animate the damage dealt, including lowering the HP
  242   #=============================================================================
  243   # Animate being damaged and losing HP (by a move)
  244   def pbAnimateHitAndHPLost(user, targets)
  245     # Animate allies first, then foes
  246     animArray = []
  247     2.times do |side|   # side here means "allies first, then foes"
  248       targets.each do |b|
  249         next if b.damageState.unaffected || b.damageState.hpLost == 0
  250         next if (side == 0 && b.opposes?(user)) || (side == 1 && !b.opposes?(user))
  251         oldHP = b.hp
  252         if b.damageState.substitute
  253           old_sub_hp = b.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] + b.damageState.hpLost
  254           PBDebug.log("[Substitute HP change] #{b.pbThis}'s substitute lost #{b.damageState.hpLost} HP (#{old_sub_hp} -> #{b.effects[PBEffects::Substitute]})")
  255         else
  256           oldHP += b.damageState.hpLost
  257         end
  258         effectiveness = 0
  259         if Effectiveness.resistant?(b.damageState.typeMod)
  260           effectiveness = 1
  261         elsif Effectiveness.super_effective?(b.damageState.typeMod)
  262           effectiveness = 2
  263         end
  264         animArray.push([b, oldHP, effectiveness])
  265       end
  266       if animArray.length > 0
  267         @battle.scene.pbHitAndHPLossAnimation(animArray)
  268         animArray.clear
  269       end
  270     end
  271   end

  278     return if target.damageState.disguise || target.damageState.iceFace

  285     elsif Effectiveness.not_very_effective?(target.damageState.typeMod)
  286       if numTargets > 1
  287         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("It's not very effective on {1}...", target.pbThis(true)))

  294   def pbHitEffectivenessMessages(user, target, numTargets = 1)
  295     return if target.damageState.disguise || target.damageState.iceFace
  296     if target.damageState.substitute
  297       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("The substitute took damage for {1}!", target.pbThis(true)))
  298     end
  299     if target.damageState.critical
  300       if $game_temp.party_critical_hits_dealt &&
  301          $game_temp.party_critical_hits_dealt[user.pokemonIndex] &&
  302          user.pbOwnedByPlayer?
  303         $game_temp.party_critical_hits_dealt[user.pokemonIndex] += 1
  304       end
  305       if target.damageState.affection_critical
  306         if numTargets > 1
  307           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} landed a critical hit on {2}, wishing to be praised!",
  308                                   user.pbThis, target.pbThis(true)))
  309         else
  310           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} landed a critical hit, wishing to be praised!", user.pbThis))
  311         end
  312       elsif numTargets > 1
  313         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("A critical hit on {1}!", target.pbThis(true)))
  314       else
  315         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("A critical hit!"))
  316       end
  317     end
  318     # Effectiveness message, for moves with 1 hit
  319     if !multiHitMove? && user.effects[PBEffects::ParentalBond] == 0
  320       pbEffectivenessMessage(user, target, numTargets)
  321     end
  322     if target.damageState.substitute && target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] == 0
  323       target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] = 0
  324       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s substitute faded!", target.pbThis))
  325     end

  368   # Used by Counter/Mirror Coat/Metal Burst/Revenge/Focus Punch/Bide/Assurance.
  369   def pbRecordDamageLost(user, target)
  370     damage = target.damageState.hpLost
  371     # NOTE: In Gen 3 where a move's category depends on its type, Hidden Power
  372     #       is for some reason countered by Counter rather than Mirror Coat,
  373     #       regardless of its calculated type. Hence the following two lines of
  374     #       code.
  375     moveType = nil
  376     moveType = :NORMAL if @function_code == "TypeDependsOnUserIVs"   # Hidden Power
  377     if !target.damageState.substitute
  378       if physicalMove?(moveType)
  379         target.effects[PBEffects::Counter]       = damage
  380         target.effects[PBEffects::CounterTarget] = user.index
  381       elsif specialMove?(moveType)
  382         target.effects[PBEffects::MirrorCoat]       = damage
  383         target.effects[PBEffects::MirrorCoatTarget] = user.index
  384       end
  385     end
  386     if target.effects[PBEffects::Bide] > 0
  387       target.effects[PBEffects::BideDamage] += damage
  388       target.effects[PBEffects::BideTarget] = user.index
  389     end
  390     target.damageState.fainted = true if target.fainted?
  391     target.lastHPLost = damage
  392     target.tookMoveDamageThisRound = true if damage > 0 && !target.damageState.substitute   # For Focus Punch
  393     target.tookDamageThisRound = true if damage > 0   # For Assurance
  394     target.lastAttacker.push(user.index)              # For Revenge
  395     if target.opposes?(user)
  396       target.lastHPLostFromFoe = damage               # For Metal Burst
  397       target.lastFoeAttacker.push(user.index)         # For Metal Burst
  398     end
  399     if $game_temp.party_direct_damage_taken &&
  400        $game_temp.party_direct_damage_taken[target.pokemonIndex] &&
  401        target.pbOwnedByPlayer?
  402       $game_temp.party_direct_damage_taken[target.pokemonIndex] += damage
  403     end
  404   end
